## Critique
- claim-1: The accepted project record supplies the stated degreewise free ranks \(1,1,2,1,1\) and zero torsion. Here “only” correctly refers to the information asserted by claim-1, not necessarily every datum contained in artifact `621a...`.
- claim-2: The proof is complete and checkable. The two marked bases of \(Q=\mathbb Z^2\) have identical invariants \((\operatorname{rank}Q,\operatorname{Tor}Q)=(2,0)\) but transition matrices
  \[
  I_2,\qquad \begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix},
  \]
  with determinants \(1\) and \(-1\). The rank-one sign ambiguity and zero-rank boundary are also explicit. Thus quotient ranks and torsion alone do not determine ordered \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) transition matrices. The scoped certificate is established; no parent theorem follows.
